panel.finding_key: packages/documentation/sheets/datasources.md::datasources doc conflates two separate dialogs into one step, describing connection-detail fields as being in the 'select datasource' dialog when they are actually in a second 'new datasource connection' dialog reached via a 'new connection' button.
panel.summary: Datasources doc conflates two separate dialogs into one step, describing connection-detail fields as being in the 'Select DataSource' dialog when they are actually in a second 'New DataSource Connection' dialog reached via a 'New Connection' button.
panel.evidence: "1. Click the + at the end of the tab bar and choose New DataSource.\n2. In the Select DataSource dialog, fill in the connection details..." — but per packages/frontend/src/components/datasource-selector.tsx, clicking 'New DataSource' opens a 'Select DataSource' picker dialog (title: 'Select DataSource', description: 'Choose an existing connection or create a new one') with no connection fields; the user must click a separate 'New Connection' button to open packages/frontend/src/components/datasource-dialog.tsx, titled 'New DataSource Connection', which actually contains Host/Port/Database/Username/Password/SSL and the 'Test Connection' button. The doc's step 2 skips this intermediate click.
